clock_fraction_15: quarter of the way toward hour H, i.e. (H-1):15 -- "negyed kilenc" == 08:15.
Citation: Rounds, Carol H. "Hungarian: An Essential Grammar", 2nd ed.,
Routledge 2009, sec. on telling the time ("negyed", "fel", "haromnegyed"
counted toward the coming hour); Wiktionary "negyed" (Hungarian), sense
clock_fraction_30: Hungarian counting-toward-the-hour clock: "fel <H>" == half of the way
toward hour H, i.e. (H-1):30 -- "fel kilenc" == 08:30 (half before nine).
Citation: Rounds, Carol H. "Hungarian: An Essential Grammar", 2nd ed.,
Routledge 2009, sec. on telling the time; Wiktionary "fel" (Hungarian).
clock_fraction_45: quarters of the way toward hour H, i.e. (H-1):45 -- "haromnegyed kilenc"
== 08:45.  Citation: Rounds, Carol H. "Hungarian: An Essential Grammar",
2nd ed., Routledge 2009, sec. on telling the time; Wiktionary
"haromnegyed" (Hungarian), sense "three quarters toward the named hour".
